verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's check-deposit page publishes turnaround terms: requests are processed and mailed out within 1 business day, banks usually process funds within a week, and express shipping is available. It also states a pay-per-deposit model with no setup or monthly fees. The fee amounts and supported banks are not shown, and the post-deposit handling of the check is only implied by "mailed out." Missing for 10: list of supported banks, actual per-deposit fee amounts, explicit statement of what happens to the physical check after deposit (e.g. retention, return or destruction), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, check deposit terms are published — supported banks, per-deposit fees, turnaround time, and what happens to the physical check afterward

citations.quote: Check deposit requests are processed and mailed out within 1 business day. Funds are usually processed by your bank within a week.
Pay per deposit with no setup or monthly fees.
